transport: Apple iPhone Mirroring through Codex CUA
isolation: Native XCTest test process was stopped and its exit verified before Mirroring started. Mirroring was fully quit afterward.
scope: Exploratory agent-driven app-opening tests. Wall time includes agent/tool turns, screenshots and recovery. Dispatch-call time is not completed-action latency. These are not comparable to driver-only direct timings.

trials.recovery: Used Return after inspecting the failed coordinate click; app opened.

trials.verification: Calculator keypad visible after query repair
trials.recovery: Replaced only the test search query after input focus was established.

trials.verification: Clock Alarms view visible; no alarm changed
trials.recovery: Separated Select All from text entry with a visible selection check; exact query then arrived.

findings: Coordinate clicking still returned noWindowsAvailable with native XCTest stopped. The earlier coordinate errors cannot be attributed solely to controller overlap.
A keyboard-only app-opening route worked, so Mirroring itself was not completely unusable.
Immediate text after opening Spotlight or selecting all lost characters in two exploratory attempts. Separate focus/selection verification repaired input.
Command-1 from an app opened through Spotlight can return to search; the actual Home state must be verified before resetting a timed trial.
The next screenshot immediately after Return could show an in-progress transition; a changed frame alone did not establish completion.
limitations: Small exploratory sample with diagnostic recovery; no general success-rate estimate.
No native direct completed-app task has yet been compared under equivalent timing boundaries.
No TikTok or Instagram Reel was published.
